reply.emotion: warm and bright, thinking of someone full of life and energy
notes: Used for both people and animals that have lived for only a short time.
Unlike in English, 'joven' can also function as a noun meaning 'young person' (el joven / la joven).

senses.definition: Que tiene pocos años de vida o de existencia.

examples.text: Mis padres eran muy jóvenes cuando se casaron.
examples.translation: My parents were very young when they got married.
examples.emotion: fond and nostalgic, remembering an earlier time

senses.definition: Que muestra las características propias de la juventud, como la energía o el entusiasmo.

examples.text: Aunque tiene ochenta años, tiene un espíritu muy joven.
examples.translation: Although he is eighty years old, he has a very youthful spirit.
examples.emotion: admiring and cheerful, praising someone's lively attitude
